lines.en: This is the Historium Magnus.  It is an ancient text written by the founders of the Donari Temple, recalling the events of the original battle with Zanatus.
lines.zh: 这是《伟大史书》 。它是由多纳尔圣殿的创始人们所撰写的古老文本，回顾了与扎纳图斯的原初之战时期的事件。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Looks like a bunch of gibberish to me...
lines.zh: 在我看来，这只是一堆胡言乱语……

lines.en: You and I will not be able to read it.  Only the Temple Grandmasters, and one protege, have gone through the years of rigorous study required to interpret it.
lines.zh: 你我不会读懂它 。只有圣殿圣宗和一名门徒，才经历过为读懂它所需的多年研习。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: How nice of the founders to keep secrets from the rest of us, don't you think?
lines.zh: 创始人们对我们其他人保密的做法可真好啊，你不觉得吗？

lines.en:
Grandmaster Oxley wishes for me to take the book.  Leaving it here is too dangerous for the innocents who live here...  you must tell no one, Protagonist.  The cult will do anything to gain the knowledge within these texts...
Lastly, he has agreed to help finance our army, to the tune of 10,000 gold pieces.  May we not squander this blessing.
lines.name: 戴安娜
